learning_outcomes.text: The technical terms and basic knowledge of renewable energies and energy storage are presented or acquired by the students. Components are assembled into systems and their function is formally described. Renewable energy and storage systems are calculated and dimensioned. The energy expenditure, expected yields and costs are estimated. Finally, ecological connections are established that justify the use of these technologies.
Students have extensive knowledge that they can apply to the special applications of renewable energy technologies and storage systems.
Students analyze technical tasks and apply learned procedures, methods, and simulation programs to develop relevant systems and investigate their performance, efficiency, yield, and effectiveness.
Students can compare different renewable energy and storage system technologies and evaluate them with regard to expected yield and energy generation costs.

Students can present the results of their investigations in a scientifically concise form and subject them to a plausibility check and evaluation. They have the information and evaluation competence to participate in the energy industry discourse.

syllabus_topics: Solar technology: Solar radiation, Solar thermal, Photovoltaics
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a term paper of 4 pages and a survey of maximum 30 minutes. The ungraded examination is experimental work consisting of approximately 2-3 experiments.
